violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. TACO ROCK 5 (Inspection Date: 04/17/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Surfaces of the can opener blade and base holder, were in contact with non-time/temperature control for safety food items that were observed soiled with accumulations of grime and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at any time when contamination may have occurred. Clean the can opener and the base/stand, more frequently to prevent food contamination. CORRECTED

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: baked chicken wings=45F, cheese stick=47F @ 2-door up right Continental refrigerator .
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Both relocated to a freezer for rapid cooling.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Large amounts of foods placed in small containers.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. Foods portioned in smaller amounts and placed in shallow trays for rapid cooling.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: CONTINENTAL 2-DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR, @ cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at one handwashing sink at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CORTRDECTEDF DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:Birria=44F, bacon jam=44F, Abanero=43F,
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash her hands before engaging in food preparation, after handling toxic chemicals utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CDI

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine in the kitchen was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. Sanitizer provided during the inspection.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F in ice-bath, within two hours. Beef, pork, shredded chicken.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CDI

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unmarked spray bottles containing toxic cleaning chemicals were not labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI

violations.corrective_action: Check the chemical containers at the dish wash washing machine regularly, to ensure that sufficient amount of soap, rinse chemical, and sanitizer are available in the containers to properly wash rinse, and sanitizer utensils and equipped at the machine. CDI

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the BAR being used AS A DUMP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. HAND SINK WITH SOAP DISPENSER AND PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER BEING USED AS A DUMP SINK. A SECONDARY SINK WAS IDENTIFIED AND EHS RECOMMENDED USING AS A DUMP SINK.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the back kitchen was blocked by boxes of fry oil, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EMPLOYEE RELOCATED OIL TO OTHER AREA IN KITCHEN. HAND SINK ACCESS CLEARED.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration HIGHER than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3 COMPARTMENT SINK with a concentration of 500 ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. - EHS INSTRUCTED CFM TO DILUTE SANITIZER TO APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: VARIOUS SALSAS AT SALSA BAR OBSERVED BETWEEN 50-60F, CONSOME ON FLAT TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. - EHS OBSERVED SALSA CONTAINERS NOT IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH ICE (SQUEEZE BOTTLE STORED IN STAINLESS STEEL CONTAINER IN BED OF ICE). EHS RECOMMENDED STORING SALSA BOTTLES IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH ICE OR CHANGING CONTAINERS. CFM WILL USE TPHC FOR SALSAS CURRENTLY BEING SERVED AND WILL CHANGE CONTAINERS. CFM WILL USE TPHC FOR CONSOME. EHS PROVIDED TPHC PROCEDURE TO CFM. CFM LABELLED CONSOME CONTAINER WITH 4 HOUR END-POINT.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: CHORIZO, VARIOUS CONTAINERS OF FOOD OBSERVED WITH PREP DATE OF 10/18 AND 10/21.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. -CFM VOLUNTARILY DISCARDED FOOD. EHS REVIEWED 7 DAY SHELF-LIFE OF IN-HOUSE PREPARED FOOD WITH CFM.

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. -OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLES OF CLEANER HANGING ON SHELVING NEXT TO SINGLE-SERVE DRINKING CUPS.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. -CFM MOVED CLEANER TO BOTTLE SHELF, AWAY FROM DRINKING CUPS. TACO ROCK 5 (Inspection Date: 11/06/2024) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED BEEF THAWING AT ROOM TEMPERATURE ON ROLLING RACK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. - EHS REVIEWED PROPER THAWING METHODS. BEEF MOVED TO WIC TO CONTINUE THAWING.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS BOTTLES AT COOK LINE WITH NO LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. - CFM HAD EMPLOYEE LABEL BOTTLES WITH FOOD NAME.
